title: Burns fluid resuscitation (Parkland)
regimen: NaCl 0.9% 4 mL × kg × %TBSA / 24 h · ½ in 8 h · titrate to urine 0.5 mL/kg/h
dagger_note: † = clinical or local addition, not in the SA STG. Any item without a source page is †; items with a page are from the cited guideline.
item_format: Items: t=text, x=detail, s=source 'source-id:printed page' (STG pages are chapter.page), s_more=extra refs, d=1 dagger, b=1 bold. steps[].actions[] are the ordered spine (flow view); steps[].sequence.rows[].cells[] are ordered fluid/drug cells (m=a/b/c); steps[].decisions[] are IF/then branches; reference.blocks[] are tables (cols/rows) or lists (items).

items.t: >10% TBSA: NaCl 0.9% IV for resuscitation, replacement and maintenance
Partial and full thickness only; not simple erythema
Inhalational injury, pharyngeal swelling, unconscious, hypoxic → intubate early
Tight circumferential trunk burn → escharotomy (consult burns centre)
Shock early after a burn → look for associated injury / internal bleeding
Electrical: cardiac monitor; suspect compartment syndrome

actions.x: hot gas, smoke, steam, soot, stridor, hoarse

actions.t: Immobilise C-spine if mechanism suggests trauma; stop bleeding

steps.title: Stop the burning, cool, keep warm
steps.subtitle: remove heat · cool <3 h burns · dry

actions.t: Remove clothing, jewellery, heat or chemical source
Cool burns <3 h old with tap water ≥30 min, then dry
Map burn on chart; add up %TBSA
actions.x: head 9 · each arm 9 · front trunk 18 · back 18 · each leg 18 · perineum 1
superficial / partial superficial / deep dermal / full thickness

actions.t: Weigh or estimate weight; note TIME OF BURN

steps.title: Calculate and start Parkland
steps.subtitle: 24-h total = 4 mL × kg × %TBSA
steps.sequence_order: a first 8 h ▶ b next 16 h ▶ c titrate hourly

actions.t: Tetanus toxoid 0.5 mL IM if none in 5 y
Feed early; pantoprazole 40 mg IV daily until feeding
Refer to burns unit: >20% TBSA, face/hands/perineum, inhalational, electrical, circumferential

blocks.h: Parkland NaCl 0.9% rate (mL/h): first 8 h / next 16 h
blocks.note: Count from the time of burn and deduct pre-hospital fluid †. Example 70 kg 30%: 8 400 mL / 24 h → 525 mL/h × 8 h, then 263 mL/h × 16 h.

items.t: Superficial: dry, erythema, painful, heals 7 d
Partial superficial: blisters, moist, painful, 10–14 d
Deep dermal: white/yellow slough, less painful → graft
Full thickness: dry, charred, painless, firm → graft
